payload.core_mechanism_summary: 2D DP where state (i, j) represents number of valid prefixes of length i+1 with the last block of equal characters starting at position j.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a 2D DP array d[i][j] to count binary strings, transitioning based on constraints a[i][j]==2, and preprocessing forced equalities with a disjoint-set-like array. This aligns with dp_2d_state.
